# Vision

<!-- generated:header (isim/tools/coverage-summary.py; do not edit by hand) -->
**Symbols:** 53.6% of Apple's iOS API (2581 of 4815, exact) · **Rows:** 27: 10 ✅ 12 🟡 1 🧩 4 ❌ · **iOS:** None+
<!-- /generated:header -->

**Area:** [Imaging, photos & ML](../COVERAGE.md#ml) · **Apple:** [Vision](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/vision) · **Issues:** [`area:ml`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Aml)

## How isim implements it

- **Passthrough:** barcodes through zbar and zxing-cpp; text through tesseract. The other requests are stubs, because they need Apple's models.
- **Objective-C:** `#import <Vision/Vision.h>` and `-framework Vision` (headers in `isim/sdk-src/Frameworks/Vision`) reach the same classes: the Swift overlay's classes are `@objc(VN…)` with their members under Apple's selectors, `isim/swift/overlays/Vision/ObjC.swift` adds the entry points that need C types (`CVPixelBufferRef`, option dictionaries, C point arrays), and `isim/frameworks/Vision/Vision.m` has the constants, `VNUtils.h`'s functions, Apple's class factories and `timeRange`.

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Vision: `VNImageRequestHandler` (CGImage, CIImage, CVPixelBuffer, CMSampleBuffer, URL, Data; orientation), `VNSequenceRequestHandler` (the same inputs), requests/observations, `regionOfInterest`, geometry helpers | ✅ | ≤17 | tested: orientation and region of interest; coordinates normalized with a lower-left origin like iOS |
| Vision `VNDetectBarcodesRequest` | 🟡 | ≤17 | passthrough: host libzbar (QR, EAN/UPC, Code 39/93/128, I2of5, Codabar, DataBar, PDF417) and zxing-cpp's ZXingReader (Aztec, Data Matrix, Micro QR; unverified in Vision, tested through AVCaptureMetadataOutput); tested: payloads and boxes of two real QR codes; without either the request fails with a clear error; MicroPDF417 and MSI Plessey are not decoded |
| Vision `VNRecognizeTextRequest` | 🟡 | ≤17 | passthrough: the host's `tesseract` (line observations, word boxes, confidence); `.fast` and `.accurate` run the same engine; unverified with tesseract (not on the test host); without it the request fails with a clear error (tested) |
| Vision `VNDetectFaceRectanglesRequest`, `VNFaceObservation` (`roll`, `landmarks`, `init(requestRevision:boundingBox:roll:yaw:pitch:)`) | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: Core Image's Viola-Jones detector (`CIDetector`, OpenCV's Haar cascades from the host's `opencv-data`); `roll` from the eye line, no `yaw` / `pitch` (nil); without the cascades the request fails with `unsupportedRequest` and says so (tested both ways: HelloVision, the astronaut portrait) |
| Vision `VNDetectFaceLandmarksRequest`, `VNFaceLandmarks2D`, `VNFaceLandmarkRegion2D` (`normalizedPoints`, `pointsInImage(imageSize:)`, `pointsClassification`, `precisionEstimatesPerPoint`), `constellation` | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: a geometric face model (pupils, eyes, brows, nose, nose crest, median line, lips, the jaw) placed by the eyes and the mouth the detector finds and turned with the eye line, so points follow the face's layout but not its exact outline; left / right as the viewer sees them; `inputFaceObservations` honoured (faces without a detection get the average proportions); tested (HelloVision) |
| Vision `VNDetectRectanglesRequest` (aspect ratios, `quadratureTolerance`, `minimumSize`, `minimumConfidence`, `maximumObservations`) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: filled quadrilaterals of either polarity (Otsu threshold, connected components, convex hull, the largest inscribed quadrilateral, fill and corner-angle checks), largest first; corners in `VNRectangleObservation`; tested (HelloVision: an upright and a turned rectangle, a ring rejected) |
| Vision `VNDetectTextRectanglesRequest` (`reportCharacterBoxes`), `VNTextObservation.characterBoxes` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: character-like connected components (dots joined to their letters) grouped into words; no OCR needed; tested (HelloVision: two words, 5 and 4 characters) |
| Vision `VNDetectContoursRequest`, `VNContoursObservation`, `VNContour` (index paths, children, `normalizedPath`, `polygonApproximation(epsilon:)`) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: Suzuki–Abe border following on the image thresholded at `contrastPivot` (nil: Otsu's threshold), outer borders and holes nested; `contrastAdjustment` is accepted but only moves mid-tones around the pivot; `maximumImageDimension` honoured; tested (HelloVision: a ring's hole holding a dot) |
| Vision `VNDetectHorizonRequest`, `VNHorizonObservation` (`angle`, `transform`, `transform(forImageWidth:height:)`) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: the dominant edge direction within 45° of horizontal (a gradient-orientation histogram weighted by edge strength); no result without a clear one; tested (HelloVision: a 10° horizon) |
| Vision `VNGenerateAttentionBasedSaliencyImageRequest`, `VNSaliencyImageObservation`, `VNPixelBufferObservation` | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: frequency-tuned colour saliency (distance from the image's mean colour in CIELAB) with a centre prior, as a 68×68 `OneComponent32Float` map; `salientObjects` are the regions above half the peak; not Apple's attention model; tested (HelloVision: a red disk) |
| Vision tracking: `VNTrackingRequest` (`inputObservation`, `trackingLevel`, `isLastFrame`, `supportedNumber(ofTrackersAndReturnError:)`), `VNTrackObjectRequest`, `VNTrackRectangleRequest`, `VNRequestTrackingLevel` | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: the object's patch in the previous frame is found in the next by normalized cross-correlation over a window of 1.5 times its size (on the frame at 320 pixels, 192 for `.fast`); the result keeps the input's `uuid`, its confidence is the correlation; state lives in the request between a `VNSequenceRequestHandler`'s frames, released after `isLastFrame`; 16 trackers. Missing: changes of scale and rotation (the box keeps its size; a rectangle's corners move with it). Tested (HelloVision, HelloVisionObjC: three frames, moves of 12 and 6 pixels) |
| Vision registration: `VNTargetedImageRequest` (the targeted CGImage, CIImage, CVPixelBuffer, CMSampleBuffer, URL and Data initializers), `VNImageRegistrationRequest`, `VNTranslationalImageRegistrationRequest`, `VNHomographicImageRegistrationRequest`, `VNImageAlignmentObservation`, `VNImageTranslationAlignmentObservation.alignmentTransform`, `VNImageHomographicAlignmentObservation.warpTransform` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: the targeted image is the floating image, the handler's the reference; the shift by sum-of-squared-differences search on an image pyramid (whole pixels at 256), the homography refined from it by Gauss–Newton over the pixels; transforms in pixels, lower-left origin, moving the floating image onto the reference. Tested (HelloVision: a shift of 10 and 6 pixels exactly, a homography of a 5% scale and a shift within 1.5 pixels; HelloVisionObjC) |
| Vision optical flow: `VNGenerateOpticalFlowRequest` (`computationAccuracy`, `outputPixelFormat`, `keepNetworkOutput`) | 🟡 | 14.0 | adapted: pyramidal block matching (±3 pixels per level, 9×9 windows) with subpixel refinement, on the handler image's grid: each pixel the motion in pixels (y down) of the targeted image's content; the field's longer side is 160, 256, 384 or 512 pixels (low to very high) or the image's; `TwoComponent32Float` or `TwoComponent16Half`. Missing: Apple's network's quality on large motions and occlusions. Tested (HelloVision: a square moved 6 and 4 pixels over a still background, the medians) |
| Vision stateful requests: `VNStatefulRequest` (`frameAnalysisSpacing`, `minimumLatencyFrameCount`), `VNTrackTranslationalImageRegistrationRequest`, `VNTrackHomographicImageRegistrationRequest`, `VNTrackOpticalFlowRequest` | ✅ | 17.0 | adapted: registration and optical flow between a `VNSequenceRequestHandler`'s consecutive frames (the previous one floating / targeted), no result for the first frame; every frame is analysed, whatever the spacing. Tested (HelloVision, HelloVisionObjC) |
| Vision's iOS 18 Swift API: `ImageRequestHandler` (CGImage, CIImage, CVPixelBuffer, CMSampleBuffer, URL, Data; `perform(_:)`, the parameter-pack `perform`, `performAll(_:)`), `VisionRequest`, `ImageProcessingRequest` (`perform(on:orientation:)`, `regionOfInterest`), `RecognizeTextRequest`, `DetectBarcodesRequest` (`BarcodeSymbology`), `DetectFaceRectanglesRequest`, `RecognizeDocumentsRequest` (text and barcode options), `RecognizedTextObservation`, `RecognizedText`, `BarcodeObservation`, `FaceObservation`, `DocumentObservation` (`Container`, `Text`, `List`, `Table`), `RectangleObservation`, `NormalizedPoint`, `NormalizedRect`, `CoordinateOrigin`, `BoundingBoxProviding`, `QuadrilateralProviding`, `VisionObservation`, `RequestDescriptor`, `VisionResult`, `VisionError`, `ComputeStage` | 🟡 | 18.0 | adapted: value types over the VN classes' engines (tesseract, zbar / zxing-cpp, Haar cascades; without one a request throws `VisionError.unsupportedRequest` with a message); requests run synchronously on the caller's task, `performAll` yields the results in order; documents are the recognized lines grouped into paragraphs (lines closer than their height), a title when the first paragraph's lines are clearly taller, and the barcodes. Tested (HelloVision: geometry, barcodes with a region of interest and a parameter pack, `performAll`, faces, text or its error) |
